tasks.label: Test Claims Explorer UI
tasks.command:
& { Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}\apps\workshop\web'; $node = if (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'node' } else { Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Microsoft Scoutesources

tasks.label: Check Claims Explorer API
tasks.command: & { $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $health = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/health'; Write-Output $health.message; $claims = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/claims'; $claims.claims | Select-Object claim_id, original_files, evidence_files, chunks | Format-Table; }

tasks.label: Verify Claims backend locally
tasks.command: & { Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}'; & '.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -m pytest 'apps\workshop\api\tests\test_claims_service.py' 'apps\workshop\api\tests\test_claims_router.py' 'apps\workshop\api\tests\test_standalone_api.py' -q; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Local Claims backend verification failed.' } }

tasks.label: Final Claims Explorer check
tasks.command: & { $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}'; git --no-pager diff --check; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Whitespace validation failed.' }; $tasks = Get-Content -LiteralPath '.vscode\tasks.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output ('Task configuration valid: ' + $tasks.tasks.Count + ' tasks'); $health = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/health'; Write-Output ('API health: ' + $health.message); $overview = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/claims'; if ($overview.claims.Count -ne 6) { throw 'Expected all six claim folders.' }; Write-Output ('Claims Explorer: ' + $overview.claims.Count + ' folders available'); }
